kingdom.subtitle: Free Roof Compact frontier, Water Continuity claim disputed
kingdom.description: A strategic frontier where merchant roofs, fungal roads, exhausted water offices, and one extremely portable home dispute who is infrastructure.

sites.description: A brass threshold stands in a patch of road that has reluctantly accepted indoor plumbing.
A roof-market settlement built above the drains, below the rain, and beside several incompatible definitions of public space.
Storm runoff sorted several decades of municipal metalwork into convenient piles and one inconvenient union.
A cultivated spore bed produces alchemical glass and increasingly specific complaints about pruning.
A sapient fungal colony has grown a bridge, three toll booths, and a constitutional theory overnight.

choices.label: Recognize the crossing
choices.result: The road remains open. Tollmold respect rises and Latchmarket receives a legal headache.

choices.label: Negotiate public passage
choices.result: Guile and local information secure free party travel without erasing the colony's claim.

choices.label: Leave it unresolved
choices.result: The event remains available and nothing expires while ignored.

sites.description: An Underworks service tunnel interprets intrusion as a maintenance request and combat as an improperly formatted reply.
The view explains the water level, the broken road, and why three mapmakers have requested reassignment.
A courier camp where parcels, rumors, and chairs are all temporarily between destinations.
The shrine promises safe passage to anyone who can prove they have already arrived.
The next kingdom begins beyond a gate whose paperwork currently outweighs the gate.

town.subtitle: Safe settlement, disputed roofline, all prices capable of testimony

locations.description: Regional equipment, field supplies, and several warranties already voided for convenience.
Guild contracts, route surveys, training records, and professional disagreement about the word delver.
A semi-safe bar. Weapons checked. Insults unrestricted. Relationships persist.
A stable Hearthfold threshold with healing, saving, and travel services.
Six opportunities with visible rewards and no real-world deadlines.
Confirmed facts, sourced reports, disputed claims, maps, and optional Lore Sauce.
A public social area where caravans, guilds, monsters, and citizens practice adjacent coexistence.

quests.summary: Enter the Courtesy Drain, file one complete expedition, and return to the exact entrance hex.
quests.reward: 45 Marks, 12 Salvage, full dungeon baseline loot
quests.risk: Hostile first-person lair with stopped-time combat
quests.consequence: Registry information improves. No route or reward is lost on defeat.

quests.summary: Resolve the constitutional fungus occupying the Cracked Mile.
quests.risk: Negotiation, toll, or optional combat in a later expansion
quests.consequence: Changes route information without deleting the colony.

quests.summary: Find the party that removed price tags from items and attached them to wildlife.
Trace a material claim that technically belongs to the Courtesy Drain.
quests.consequence: Adds a travel option and a future social dispute.

quests.summary: Confirm which moving structures are residents, vehicles, or ambitious fungi.
quests.risk: Low, unless a bridge answers incorrectly

quests.summary: Collect evidence that the Rain Treasurer's mandate is still legally active.
quests.consequence: Prepares the later Gutterbloom zone arc.

lore_fragments.text: Floodgate 9 remains officially closed. The water has appealed and is currently winning.
lore_fragments.hint: Standing water strengthens some electrical interactions.

lore_fragments.text: Municipal historians insist this crater was always a customs office. The crater has declined to correct them.
lore_fragments.hint: Disputed history can still identify an old route.

lore_fragments.text: The local ale is brewed from a fungus that remembers taxes. This explains the bitterness and several outstanding warrants.
lore_fragments.hint: Bars collect relationship and route rumors.

lore_fragments.text: The shrine promises safe passage to anyone who can demonstrate that they have already arrived.
lore_fragments.hint: Shrines may trade proofs instead of currency.

lore_fragments.text: Three guilds claim this bridge. None claim the underside.
lore_fragments.hint: The underside remains a possible hidden route.

lore_fragments.text: The map calls this an abandoned mine. The invoices call it fully staffed.
lore_fragments.hint: Outdated maps may hide active resource sites.

lore_fragments.text: The Courtesy Drain accepts every weapon strike as a maintenance reply. It has never accepted the tone.
At Skip Nall's camp, chairs are parcels that have briefly lost confidence.
lore_fragments.hint: Traveling social sites can move after a Strategic Pulse.

lore_fragments.text: Latchmarket imports soil from ground level and exports the certainty that this was somebody else's idea.
lore_fragments.hint: Town prosperity follows visible trade routes.

lore_fragments.text: The anchor is seven legal inches from the road and several impossible miles from the Hearthfold.
lore_fragments.hint: Discovered anchors preserve exact return positions.

lore_fragments.text: The eastern gate's paperwork currently outweighs the gate. This is considered structural reinforcement.
lore_fragments.hint: Future kingdom travel begins at visible border sites.

lore_fragments.text: The Remembering Garden has filed a pruning complaint naming everyone who walked past with scissors.
lore_fragments.hint: Resource sites can develop named social consequences.
